name: Adbeel
overview: Adbeel is a male figure identified as the third-born son of Ishmael. He belongs to the tribe of Adbeel, as indicated by his lineage. Beyond his position within Ishmael's family, Scripture provides no further details about his life or actions.
namesAndTitles: The name Adbeel means '[the] grief of G-d [El],' reflecting a Hebrew origin. This proper name is recorded in Genesis 25:13 and was not given by God directly. The meaning may suggest a significance tied to sorrow or judgment, though the text does not elaborate further.
familyAndRelationships: Adbeel is explicitly recorded as a son of Ishmael, making him part of the Ishmaelite lineage. Scripture does not mention any other family relationships or descendants for Adbeel beyond this connection.
scriptureSignificance: Adbeel's primary significance in the biblical narrative is his place within the genealogy of Ishmael, marking the continuation of Abraham's lineage through his son Ishmael. As the third-born son, he represents one of the tribes descending from Ishmael, which is important for understanding the broader family structure and tribal divisions mentioned in Genesis. Although not a central figure in biblical events, his inclusion underscores the detailed record-keeping of God's covenantal family line.
